title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・敗戦の喜び

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But that's the best I could've done… So I feel kind of okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Nice work, McQueen. You beat me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You really are incredible. I'm disappointed obviously, but I'm also kind of happy, hehe…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan, happy even after a loss… That carefree expression on your face is a curious thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But it's only natural that I beat you at this distance. I've been working toward it my entire life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The victory belongs to Mejiro McQueen, but the battle to get there was a fierce one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll surpass you in your specialty, the medium-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A medium-distance race… Which one would that be? Any ideas, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The medium-distance championship in the spring is the Takarazuka Kinen. In response to Mejiro McQueen, we make that our goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in the end, it's the fans who will decide what happens, leaving us unsure of how high we can aim for.
